title: Machine-learned particle flow as a foundation model for collider physics
abstract: arXiv:2606.14373v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The workflow from particle collision to physics analysis passes through a series of reconstruction steps that are traditionally modular and disconnected, with no shared representation linking low-level detector data to high-level analysis tasks. We show that casting event reconstruction as a machine learning problem naturally produces such a shared representation. We repurpose a machine learning model trained for particle-flow reconstruction (MLPF) to perform three distinct analysis tasks: jet flavor identification, jet energy regression, and missing momentum regression. By appending the per-particle latent representations learned during reconstruction as additional input features, we substantially improve over baselines that use conventional particle-level features alone. translated_title: 机器学习粒子流作为对撞机物理的基础模型
translated_abstract: 从粒子对撞到物理分析的工作流程需要经过一系列传统上模块化且相互独立的重建步骤，缺乏将低层次探测器数据与高层次分析任务联系起来的共享表示。我们证明，将事件重建转化为机器学习问题可以自然地产生这种共享表示。我们将为粒子流重建（MLPF）训练的机器学习模型重新用于执行三种不同的分析任务：喷注味道识别、喷注能量回归和丢失动量回归。通过将在重建过程中学到的逐粒子潜在表示作为额外的输入特征，我们相比仅使用传统粒子级特征的基线方法取得了显著改进。我们进一步证明，仅使用潜在表示训练的单一线性层即可达到与最先进基线方法具有竞争力的性能。
tldr: 该论文证明将在事件重建（MLPF）中学到的逐粒子潜在表示作为共享的基础模型表示，可显著提升喷注味道识别、喷注能量回归和丢失动量回归等多种对撞机物理分析任务的性能。
